attempts.question: wallpaper kaise badlu?
attempts.replyText: system settings ke sidebar mein Wallpaper pe click karo, wahan se change kar sakte ho.

attempts.question: battery ki health kahan dekhu?
attempts.replyText: battery health dekhne ke liye sidebar mein Battery pe click karo.

attempts.question: mac ki language hindi kaise karu?
attempts.replyText: Language and Region settings mein jaakar mac ki language hindi kar sakte hain.

attempts.question: date aur time galat hai, kahan theek karu?
attempts.replyText: date and time theek karne ke liye General settings mein Date and Time pe click karo.

attempts.question: airdrop kahan se on hota hai?
attempts.replyText: airdrop on karne ke liye General settings ke andar AirDrop and Handoff pe click karo.

attempts.question: is text ko bold kaise karu?
attempts.replyText: text ko select karne ke baad upar toolbar mein B pe click karo, woh bold ho jayega.

attempts.question: document mein table kaise daalu?
attempts.replyText: document mein table insert karne ke liye upar toolbar mein table icon pe click karo.

attempts.question: photo insert karni hai
attempts.replyText: photo add karne ke liye upar toolbar mein picture icon pe click karo.

attempts.question: ye document share kaise karu?
attempts.replyText: document share karne ke liye top right corner mein jo share icon hai, uspe click karo.

attempts.question: numbered list banani hai
attempts.replyText: top toolbar mein numbered list wala icon click kar do, wahan se list ban jayegi.

attempts.question: password bhool gaya, ab kya karu?
attempts.replyText: yahan password box ke paas blue color mein Forgot password link hai, uspe click karo.

attempts.question: naya account kaise banau?
attempts.replyText: naya account banane ke liye box ke neeche diye gaye Create an account link pe click karo.

attempts.question: google se login karna hai
attempts.replyText: continue with google pe click karo.

attempts.question: remember me wala tick kahan hai?
attempts.replyText: Remember me ke bagal mein hai chhota sa box, uspe click kar do.

attempts.question: email kahan daalu?
attempts.replyText: email address yahan email field mein likh do.

attempts.question: naya folder kaise banau?
attempts.replyText: naya folder banane ke liye menu mein New Folder pe click karo.

attempts.question: is file ki info kaise dekhu?
attempts.replyText: isse info dekhne ke liye file menu mein Get Info pe click karo.

attempts.question: file ko zip kaise karu?
attempts.replyText: file ko zip karne ke liye compress pe click karo.

attempts.question: ye file delete karni hai
attempts.replyText: file ko delete karne ke liye menu mein move to trash pe click karo.

attempts.question: file ki copy banani hai
attempts.replyText: duplicate select karne ke liye file menu mein Duplicate pe click karo.

attempts.question: bina save kiye band karna hai
attempts.replyText: agar changes nahi chahiye toh don't save pe click kar do.

attempts.question: haan save kar do
attempts.replyText: save karne ke liye blue wale button pe click kar do.

attempts.question: ruko, abhi band nahi karna
attempts.replyText: are arre, cancel pe click kar do taaki file band na ho.

attempts.question: nayi sheet kaise add karu?
attempts.replyText: sheet1 ke bagal mein jo plus ka icon hai, wahan click kar do nayi sheet aa jayegi.

attempts.question: zoom thoda badhana hai
attempts.replyText: neeche right corner mein jo zoom slider hai, usko aage badha do.

attempts.question: zoom kam karna hai
attempts.replyText: neeche right corner mein jo zoom slider hai, usko minus wale icon ki taraf drag kar lo.

attempts.replyText: total nikalne ke liye formula bar mein `=SUM(B2:B11)` type karke enter dabao, jaise yahan B2 se B11 tak ka sum ho raha hai.

attempts.question: is data ka chart banana hai
attempts.replyText: chart banane ke liye pehle apna sara data select kar lo, row 1 se row 11 tak.
